explication: Humanize is a Claude Code plugin for turning ideas into plans and iteratively implementing them with independent Codex review. Its principal workflow runs from optional idea generation through plan generation/refinement to the RLCR loop. The README also documents research, monitoring, agent-team execution, and the Bitter Lesson memory workflow. Internal details are limited to the sampled todo-checking hook; other links reflect README-documented behavior, not inspected implementation.
